hook: A SARS-CoV-2 protease triggers sneezing in mice by switching on pain-sensing neurons.
summary: The coronavirus protein PLpro directly activated airway pain neurons in mice and in human stem cell-derived neurons, causing sneezing, coughing and pain signals. This needed both PLpro's cutting activity and the TRPA1 ion channel. The work is in mice and cultured cells, so it is unproven that it explains symptoms in people.
title: A coronavirus protease activates sensory neurons via TRPA1 to drive sneeze, cough, and pain.
